chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
If a man possesses a revealing quality, wait and see his other qualities.

key_terms.أَخَوَاتِهَا: Its sisters/related qualities (implying consistency in character)
key_terms.خَلَّةٌ: A distinctive, prominent, or revealing quality/trait

ai.seo_question: How to assess a person's true character based on their visible traits?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s epistemology of character, this hadith highlights the principle of 'consistency of traits' (istiqrar al-khuluq), suggesting that a single prominent virtue or vice is rarely isolated but part of a cohesive cluster. Shia scholars interpret this as a practical heuristic for social discernment, warning against judging individuals by a single act while encouraging the observation of behavioral patterns to reveal one's true nature (fitrah).

en.sayed-ali-raza: 445. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
If a man possesses a revealing quality wait and see his other qualities. [1]
